blockingLoop.evidence: Identical panel 'To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below' shown four times with near-identical paragraphs 'The broken plastic tongue ... safety switch isn't being engaged' repeated across three consecutive turns while no progress was made

rationale: The assistant correctly identified the snapped door tongue as the reason the door switch isn't engaged and rightly withheld naming a specific part until the Hotpoint model number was known, which matches the ground truth direction. However, it then stalled in a loop, re-stating the same diagnosis and re-showing the same model-number panel three times instead of adding value (e.g. telling the customer what the Hotpoint model code looks like, advising not to tape or bypass the door switch meanwhile, or noting the catch/striker is a simple DIY fit). It also slightly misread the evidence, repeatedly suggesting the door 'won't open' when the customer said it swings open. Safe and on the right track, but unfinished and repetitive.
